scope: Conditional native exact-complex witness. At the X=439 and X=444 triangle-hybrid slot sites of the seven-slot k8 word the two-donation slot is replaced by a single source-holder donation with FULL-cleanup restore and the full read-set exchange of its copy pair; all frames are refitted exactly. Entrance and end frames, helper widths, #1148 joint-entrance T16 owners and the unchanged PR589 bit supplier are retained. PR559 exact-cover recurrence correction, bit bad-residue surcharge and H1-H5 retained. All-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape and analytic transfer remain assumptions. No unconditional theorem or full Lean certification.
